pages.text: Melee hit on a hostile: 12% chance of roots for 3s; bosses receive Slowness II. Cooldown 20s.
Melee hit on a hostile: 10% chance to heal 2 HP. Cooldown 15s.
Water movement efficiency +0.2; halves underwater air consumption. Does not grant Water Breathing.

Requires equipped Trinkets slots: rings hand/ring/offhand/ring; charms feet/aglet. Without Trinkets items remain available but inactive. Duplicates do not stack; ring swapping cannot reset saved player cooldowns. Secondary damage cannot trigger rings.
